name: Hive 1.10.3
notes: Workspace experience improvements. Hive now remembers the folder you chose and reopens it on launch instead of starting empty. The Code view (editor + terminal + file tree) and the Diff view are reachable without first opening a chat, since they work on the whole workspace. And opening or switching a workspace lands you on its most-recent chat, so People, Agents & tools, Review and the other panels are populated instead of showing an empty shell. Builds on 1.10.2's launch-hang fix and 1.10.0's built-in code editor.
